messages:
Anya: quick thread on the compact two-column capacity editor mock i dropped into the drive. main goals: surface min/max + burst controls in a single row for small screens, keep cost forecast visible, and avoid users confusing burst with reserved capacity. Mike: saw it. compact layout looks clean but worried about discoverability for advanced options (burst duration, pool affinity). can we hide advanced under a chevron but not collapse the cost sparkline? Jess: +1. also microcopy: current label `Burst` feels too terse. propose `Burst (temporary)` and an inline duration selector like `10m / 30m / 1h` so users know expectations. Ben: backend reminder 14: burst duration options map to different autoscaler policies. 10m uses fast-evict spot, 1h may need reserved fallback. will add supported options to API. Ravi: for the min/max steppers, keyboard should support aria-valuenow and delta with arrow keys. propose: arrow = 1, pageup/pagedown = 10, shift+arrow = 5. also announce when value clipped to pool capacity. Sam: accessibility notes: need aria-live region for the forecast message and guardrail changes. suggested pattern:
Cost estimate: $0.42/hr - within budget
. ensure color is not sole indicator. Lena: design: the cost sparkline should be subtlelight stroke and 2px marker at the handle. numeric estimate move to the right aligned with CTA so mobile users see impact before saving. Mike: contrast nit: the muted text for the small label `per GPU / hr` fails AA at 12px. darken by 10-15% or increase font weight. Jess: copy variants for confirmation when min > recommended: 1) "Min exceeds recommended capacity for this pool." 2) "This min may increase costs and degrade SLOs." Which is clearer? Anya: prefer #1 for brevity with a secondary line explaining cost/SLO impact and a link "Why this matters". Ben: on override flow: prefer inline confirm instead of modal. show two buttons: "Save anyway" (primary), "Adjust to recommendation" (secondary). telemetry: record override reason. Ravi: pool affinity toggle idea: small tag on pool tile "GPU: A100" or "GPU: T4" and a tooltip showing `Compatible: all | quantized-only`. saves clicks for platform folks. Sam: keyboard focus order must be: pool selector -> min -> max -> burst -> save. if advanced opens, focus should move into advanced and trap until closed. Lena: visual suggestion: when user changes min/max rapidly, debounce cost calculation but show a skeleton spinner on the forecast area to indicate recalculation. avoid janky numbers. design-bot: new mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/compact-capacity-editor - frames: "Two-col-compact", "Burst-duration-picker", "Pool-tile-affinities". Anya: action items: I'll update microcopy (Burst (temporary)), move numeric estimate right, and tweak layout for focus order. Jess please write the 2-3 copy lines for the copy doc. Sam please add aria-live snippets to the a11y checklist. Mike/Ravi/Bob? (Ben) check API constraints and quota behavior. we'll reconvene after updates. :thumbsup: Mike: will prototype contrast and sparkline animation. Jess: drafting copy now, will ping for review. Ben: will enumerate backend limits and send a short doc with exact durations supported. Sam: i'll run quick axe pass once PR lands and flag any remaining a11y fails. Ravi: will add pool affinity data to the pool list endpoint. Anya: thanks all, nice progress.
